description: Build an HTTP Referrer-Policy response-header value from one or more policy tokens (a fallback chain per the Referrer Policy spec), with a plain-English explanation of each token and warnings for risky choices like unsafe-url. Pure string assembly and lookup, not validated against live request traffic.

policies.description: One or more Referrer-Policy tokens forming a fallback chain, e.g. ["strict-origin-when-cross-origin"]

name: build_referrer_policy
